en.title: Maximum Points When Each Purchase Lowers the Remaining Rewards
en.description:
Each item can be bought at most once. Buying an item earns its current points, after which the points of every other unbought item decrease by 1, but not below 0. You may choose any purchase order and any number of purchases. Find the maximum total points.

This site independently compiled the standard I/O and editorial; additions for bounds missing from the sources and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n and the second line contains n initial point values. The original bounds are 1≤n≤100000, 0≤deals[i]≤1000000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are 7; 12; and 1, checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Sort by initial points in descending order; the i-th purchase (counting from 0) earns max(0,a[i]−i). Sum these values.
